high_level_description: This image is a social media post from the Instagram account "hindu_gurukul_." The post features a map at the top with the title "Lost Kumari Kandam" prominently displayed. The map highlights an area labeled "Kumari Kandam," which is colored orange and situated between Africa and Asia, suggesting it is a region submerged beneath the Indian Ocean. Below the map, there is an underwater scene showing scuba divers exploring what appears to be the ruins of an ancient structure. The structure looks like a temple or a large stone formation, indicating historical significance.
